dropped.reason: MISSING ENGINE MACHINERY (spot-check-caught): the domain-image mapping is a REQUIRED positional free-string ('ab-abba') that CDP parses directly from argv (cdp2k/tklib3.c:646 read_shuffle_data / get_domain_and_image - no file fallback), but the engine's validate_params rejects plain-string values for non-aux_file params (processing.py _check_type: 'Strings are only accepted for breakpoint file paths (must end in .brk)'). An entry was drafted and passed the loader, but the process_impl spot-check failed with that exact param_type error, so every process() call would fail; entry withdrawn. Precedent: specfnu's optional -o str switch is shipped documented as execute()-only - viable there because it is optional, impossible here because the string is the entry's core required parameter. What is missing: plain-string parameter support in _check_type (and string-aware duration handling). Fully probed regardless (transcript section 3): duration rule outwindows = 1 + floor((inwindows-1)/(dmncnt*grpsize))*imgcnt*grpsize exact in 7 probes at 2 durations; verbatim data validation errors; grpsize 1-32767 + brk refusal; deterministic; reachable today via execute().
